proximityEnabled.Name: Proximity Awareness
proximityEnabled.Hint: Allied tokens in the player's proximity stay visible through the Fog of War.

proximityRange.Name: Proximity Range (grid spaces)
proximityRange.Hint: Radius of the proximity area in which ally tokens stay visible.

proximityTargets.Name: Proximity Targets
proximityTargets.Hint: Token types affected by proximity. Tokens with a secret disposition are never revealed.

proximityWallsBlock.Name: Walls Block Proximity
proximityWallsBlock.Hint: Enable if a sight-blocking wall should prevent proximity awareness.

lastKnownEnabled.Name: Last Known Positions
lastKnownEnabled.Hint: Mark the position where a tracked token was the last time the player saw it.

lastKnownDispositions.Name: Tracked Tokens
lastKnownDispositions.Hint: Which tokens, other than allies, to track for last known position markers.

lastKnownAllies.Name: Track Allies
lastKnownAllies.Hint: Mark the position where an allied token was the last time the player saw it.

lastKnownShare.Name: Share Sightings With Party
lastKnownShare.Hint: Let other players see a marker for tokens the player is tracking. When the player loses sight of them, the marker stays where it was last seen.

lastKnownShareProximity.Name: Limit Share Sightings To Proximity
lastKnownShareProximity.Hint: Share sightings only within a group of allies in proximity of each other, as set by Proximity Range and Walls Block Proximity. Allies who meet exchange their markers, and markers stay when an ally leaves. Used only when Proximity Awareness and Share Sightings With Party are on.

lastKnownLifetime.Name: Marker Lifetime (rounds)
lastKnownLifetime.Hint: Remove markers after this many rounds. Set to 0 to keep markers until the token is seen again. Outside combat, elapsed time is converted to rounds.

lastKnownClearEmpty.Name: Clear Empty Markers
lastKnownClearEmpty.Hint: When the player sees a marked spot again and the tracked token is no longer there, the marker fades out.

lastKnownClearDelay.Name: Clear Delay (seconds)
lastKnownClearDelay.Hint: How long an empty marked spot must stay in view before its marker fades out.

lastKnownShowGM.Name: Show Markers to Game Master
lastKnownShowGM.Hint: Show markers for the GM while the GM is controlling a token. Those markers are not shared with players. To share what a token sees, turn on Share Sightings With Party for that token.

lastKnownStyle.Name: Marker Appearance
lastKnownStyle.Label: Customize Markers
lastKnownStyle.Hint: Choose and/or configure how position markers look for hostiles and allies.

ClearMarkers.Name: Clear Last Known Positions
ClearMarkers.Hint: Remove all last known position markers on the current scene.

ShareSightings.Name: Share Sightings With Party
ShareSightings.Hint: While the GM controls this token, its sightings are shared with the players. Used only when every token the GM controls shares and the world setting Share Sightings With Party is on.

TabHints.enemy: Markers for every tracked token that is not an ally.
TabHints.ally: Markers for player-owned and friendly tokens.

Preset.Name: Preset
Preset.Hint: Fill in this tab with a ready-made style fitting the game world. Adjust to your liking.

color.Name: Custom Color
color.Hint: Used only when Color is set to Custom color.

scale.Name: Size
scale.Hint: Marker size relative to the token that was seen.

ringWidth.Name: Outline Thickness
ringWidth.Hint: Thickness as a fraction of the grid size.

fillOpacity.Name: Fill Opacity
fillOpacity.Hint: Opacity of the fill inside the shape. Set to 0 for no fill.

imagePath.Name: Custom Image
imagePath.Hint: Used only when Image is set to Custom image.

labelText.Name: Custom Label
labelText.Hint: Used only when Label is set to Custom text. {rounds} is replaced with the number of rounds since the sighting.

animationSpeed.Name: Animation Cycle (seconds)
animationSpeed.Hint: How long one pulse or one full turn takes.
